metadata.question: Did surface water extent in Keechelus Lake, Washington, decrease between July 2024 and July 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Keechelus Lake, Washington (need to define coordinates) - Dates: July 2024 vs July 2025 - Collection: JRC Global Surface Water or Sentinel-2 water detection - Since we need recent data (2024-2025), JRC may not be updated. Use Sentinel-2 with NDWI/MNDWI 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds using Sentinel-2 QA band - Calculate water extent using NDWI (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR) or MNDWI - Threshold water: NDWI > 0 or MNDWI > 0 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: If water extent is legitimately 0 or decreased (Answer A or B) - C1: No images found for one or both periods - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after cloud masking - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - Compare pixel counts of water between two periods ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Keechelus Lake geometry (approximate center and buffer) const keechelus = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.3514, 47.2947]).buffer(2000); // 2. Date ranges const date2024Start = '2024-07-01'; const date2024End = '2024-07-31'; const date2025Start = '2025-07-01'; const date2025End = '2025-07-31'; // 3. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 4. Water detection function using MNDWI function addWater(image) { const mndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('water'); const waterMask = mndwi.gt(0); return image.addBands(waterMask); } // 5. Get Sentinel-2 data for July 2024 let col2024 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(keechelus) .filterDate(date2024Start, date2024End) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addWater); const size2024 = col2024.size().getInfo(); console.log(`July 2024 images found: ${size2024}`); if (size2024 === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-2 data for July 2024'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 6. Get Sentinel-2 data for July 2025 let col2025 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(keechelus) .filterDate(date2025Start, date2025End) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addWater); const size2025 = col2025.size().getInfo(); console.log(`July 2025 images found: ${size2025}`); if (size2025 === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-2 data for July 2025'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 7. Create composite and calculate water extent const water2024 = col2024.select('water').median(); const water2025 = col2025.select('water').median(); // 8. Calculate statistics const stats2024 = water2024.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: keechelus, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const waterPixels2024 = stats2024.water_sum || 0; const validPixels2024 = stats2024.water_count || 0; console.log(`2024: Water pixels = ${waterPixels2024}, Valid pixels = ${validPixels2024}`); if (validPixels2024 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for July 2024 after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } const stats2025 = water2025.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: keechelus, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const waterPixels2025 = stats2025.water_sum || 0; const validPixels2025 = stats2025.water_count || 0; console.log(`2025: Water pixels = ${waterPixels2025}, Valid pixels = ${validPixels2025}`); if (validPixels2025 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for July 2025 after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 9. Check for calculation failures if (waterPixels2024 === null || waterPixels2025 === null) { console.log('Calculation returned null values'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 10. Compare water extent const decrease = waterPixels2025 < waterPixels2024; const percentChange = ((waterPixels2025 - waterPixels2024) / waterPixels2024 * 100).toFixed(2); console.log(`Change: ${percentChange}% (${waterPixels2024} -> ${waterPixels2025} pixels)`); if (decrease) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
